artifact.rule: Non-English documentary text is never machine-translated and is not interpreted through an adjudicator's own language skills. A predicate whose only relevant evidence within budget is non-English is coded UNRESOLVED with reason TRANSLATION_NOT_AVAILABLE. English-language first-party pages reachable by the frozen navigation (e.g. a first-party English version linked from the page) are used normally.
artifact.language_identification: the page's declared <html lang> value when present, otherwise the adjudicator's record 'non-English (language: <ISO 639-1 or unknown>)'; no detector software
retained: adjudicator's final predicate code and reason
artifact.why_no_mt: Explicit prospective custodian decision: no machine translation; unavailable translation is UNRESOLVED, never negative.

controlling_clause: roles.json R07 ('one pinned offline tool and language detector'); decision-protocol.json navigation.translation ('non-English pages only through the registered translation tool; uncertain translation => UNRESOLVED'); Freeze-1.1 §4; explicitly authorised by Freeze 1.2.1
conditions: Declared bias: surfaces documented only in non-English languages become UNRESOLVED (excluded from S_G), narrowing A1 toward English-documented surfaces; the count of TRANSLATION_NOT_AVAILABLE codes is reported.
